name: Chloride confirmation two-clip pilot
description: One fixed close-up test tube shot with short explanatory cards.
subject: Chemistry
educational_goal: Show the visible chloride confirmatory test described in the NCERT Class XI chemistry laboratory manual, Unit 7.

metadata.title_text:
Chloride ion test
One test tube, two observations

scene.scene: One transparent test tube of clear salt solution already acidified with dilute nitric acid. A dropper containing clear silver nitrate solution is held over its opening.
scene.camera: Locked close-up of the same tube and dropper

prompt_bundle.motion_prompt: From the exact starting image, one clear drop falls from the dropper into the test tube. A small curdy white precipitate appears where it enters and remains visible. The tube, rack, hand and camera stay fixed. Stop after this single drop.
prompt_bundle.negative_prompt: extra test tubes, new apparatus, colored solution, yellow or brown solid, flames, smoke, shaking, zoom, pan, unreadable labels

metadata.title_text:
Observation
A curdy white precipitate appears

scene.scene: The same test tube now contains the white precipitate formed in the previous shot.

prompt_bundle.motion_prompt: Continue from the exact previous test-tube frame. A small amount of clear ammonium hydroxide solution enters the same tube. The existing white precipitate gradually dissolves, leaving a clear solution. Keep the tube, rack and camera fixed; show no other action.
prompt_bundle.negative_prompt: new tube, new precipitate, colored solution, flames, smoke, shaking, zoom, pan, changing background, text

metadata.title_text:
Chloride is indicated
Follow the manual's waste instructions
